_comment: Reference-only baggage summary for airlines common on Europe->Brazil routes. Rules change often and vary by fare class and route — always verify on the airline's own site and at check-in. Edit freely.

airlines.carryOn: 1 bag up to 12 kg + 1 small accessory (Economy).
airlines.checkedEconomy: Often 1 × 23 kg on intercontinental Economy; lowest 'Light' fares may exclude checked bags.
airlines.infant: Lap infant: usually 1 × 23 kg checked bag + a collapsible stroller/car seat.
airlines.notes: Confirm at booking — checked allowance depends on the fare (Light/Standard/Flex).

airlines.carryOn: 1 bag up to 8 kg + 1 personal item.
airlines.checkedEconomy: Typically 1 × 23 kg to Brazil on Basic/Classic; Discount fares are carry-on only.
airlines.infant: Lap infant: 1 × 10 kg checked bag + stroller.
airlines.notes: Brazil routes sometimes allow 2 bags on higher fares — check your fare.

airlines.carryOn: 1 bag up to 8 kg + 1 personal item.
airlines.checkedEconomy: 1 × 23 kg on most intercontinental Economy; 'Light' fares carry-on only.
airlines.notes: Allowance shown during booking for your exact fare.

airlines.checkedEconomy: Usually 1 × 23 kg to Brazil; 'Light' fares exclude checked bags.
airlines.notes: Second bag purchasable; cheaper online than at the airport.

airlines.carryOn: 1 bag up to 10 kg + 1 personal item.
airlines.checkedEconomy: 1 × 23 kg on long-haul Economy; 'Basic' fares carry-on only.
airlines.notes: Verify — Iberia and partner-operated flights can differ.
